content.label: My daughter is 4, but she is autistic. She reads on a 1st/2nd grade level, can add, subtract up to digit numbers, tells time by a digital and analog clock— and because of that, this game is far too easy for her. She gets bored and starts answering the questions wrong just to see what will happen. Maybe update with a skills test, and then match the child up with curriculum that is in their skill range rather than age level
